headline: Proposed parking ordinance changes to City Code and a request for state law allowing digital posting of legal notices.
summary: The committee will discuss an ordinance that would change chapters 3 and 169 of the City Code on parking. A separate order would ask the State for special legislation to allow the city to post legal notices digitally.
items: Parking ordinance amending chapters 3 and 169 of the City Code (188-26)
Petition to the State for special legislation allowing digital posting of legal notices (192-26)
location: Legislative Building, 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA
